name: use-automations
title: useRuleBuilder
description: useRuleBuilder: the automations block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the automations block (`npx better-supabase add automations`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/automations.
